description:
A robotics engineer needs to convert a 2D SVG outline into a 3D-printable solid part.

Import the SVG file located at ~/Documents/FreeCAD/hc_sr04_mount.svg into FreeCAD. This SVG contains the 2D outline of a sensor mounting plate for an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor, including:
- An outer rounded rectangle (60 mm × 30 mm, 3 mm corner radii)
- Four M3 mounting holes (3.2 mm diameter) near the corners
- Two sensor bore cutouts (16 mm diameter) centered on the plate

Your tasks:
1. Import the SVG file into FreeCAD (as geometry/paths).
2. Extrude the outer plate outline to a thickness of 3 mm to create a solid plate.
3. Cut through-holes using the six circular profiles (4 mounting holes + 2 sensor bores).
4. Save the final 3D part as ~/Documents/FreeCAD/sensor_mount.FCStd.

The saved file must contain a valid 3D solid with approximate bounding box 60×30×3 mm and through-holes for the mounting hardware and sensors.
